evidence: clinical-case.schema.json does not define or require family_id or split
export_training_data.py accepts case objects without resolving their family manifest
behavioral probe: an explicitly split=heldout synthetic case with an approved SFT candidate is exportable
failures.risk: Held-out/regression contamination can occur at the interface boundary even when family manifests document a leakage rule.
failures.next_version_direction: Bind immutable family/suite/split provenance to materialized cases and make training export fail closed for heldout/regression partitions. Do not patch individual case IDs.

failures.risk: The current P0 families are useful development fixtures but cannot be represented as release-grade clinical gold or independently validated benchmark truth.
failures.next_version_direction: Add a machine-enforced release predicate. Keep unreviewed families development-only; do not fabricate or infer expert approval.

evidence: graph_eval has no required list for required_node_ids, required_edge_ids, or expected_reasoning_path
failures.risk: Future case materialization can silently lose diagnostic decision-node structure while remaining schema-valid, weakening causal diagnosis of model failures.
failures.next_version_direction: Strengthen the generic case contract so diagnostic decision nodes are mandatory where applicable, with an explicit typed exemption rather than per-case hardcoding.

non_failures.detail: Gold-only sentinel did not enter the prompt rendered by model_harness.py.
